_comment: Crop farming as a Cai-only world map loop: 8 recorded mechanics, 4 uses for the crops, and an explicit list of what no source has recorded yet. The mechanism rows come from a community write-up that names Game8 as its own source and marks its figures unverified, so nothing here is graded higher than community-reported except the two facts a second publication confirms.

_mechanics.value: Crop farming is a Cai-only world map mechanic.
It unlocks by progressing Cai's Part I route to Chapter 6, after which an empty unmarked pentagon-shaped tile appears on the world map.
_mechanics.note: The pentagon tile and the plant-then-wait loop are recorded by two independent publications.

_mechanics.value: How many crops you can grow at once is set by Renown: one plot at Renown 6 or below, two from Renown 7, three from Renown 9.
Seeds are not a separate item: you plant crops you already hold in your bag through the Farm option. Where the first crops come from is not recorded by any source checked.
Passing turns fills a growth gauge, and the tile is ready to harvest once it is full.
_mechanics.note: Both the community write-up and Fextralife describe waiting a few turns for the harvest.

_mechanics.value: A harvested tile regrows a few more times before it is emptied for good.
New Farm lets you swap the crop immediately instead of waiting, at the cost of the current crop's whole yield.
Fertiliser comes from the stable, or from a failed animal capture, and applying it raises the chance of a rarer crop at harvest.
_mechanics.note: No source gives the size of the increase or a rarity split.

_openGaps: No crop list: no source checked names the individual crops.
No yields or season data: the community write-up states plainly that it found neither.
No fertiliser numbers: the increase in rare-crop odds is not quantified anywhere.
No turn counts: the growth gauge is described without a number of turns.
No seed source: how a player first obtains crops to plant is not recorded.

uses.detail: Crops are turned in for quest item requests, which is the simplest reason to keep a stock.
Crops are traded with Vandahl Trading Co. merchants found on the world map, and later with their stall in the port area of Dagsion, in exchange for weapons and accessories.
At a Rest Spot inside a dungeon, crops restore HP and spell uses.
A crop is the weekly food that starts Pale Raven Bird Time, which is the reason the farming loop matters beyond money.
